reviews.text:
Independently owned practice with all the resources of a large one.
They saved the life of our dog once, but they are also excellent and well-priced for regular care.
Seen quickly, vet was knowledgeable and helpful and treated my dog on the floor when I explained that she doesn’t like the examination table.
Hi, Simon. We appreciate the rating, and are glad we could provide you with a positive experience!
the vet itself provides good services however customer service along with a couple of financial issues along the way prevents me from giving a higher rating
Receptionist was very helpful

We have always found the vetinerary care very good. However, the processes for collecting medication need to be improved. We regularly have to wait for over 30 minutes, when we have been told it is ready to collect (and when we arrive, on multiple occasions, have been told it's not been signed off). Sometimes the wait is because it is understandably busy, but other times it's just because the medication is held in a room where an appointment is taking place. We find the individuals friendly and helpful, but the processes could do with improvement, and communications kept consistent so each staff member can pick up the file and know where it stands.
Very friendly, professionals and kind people. Both the doctor and the receptionist. I appreciate them accessing little Trixie as an emergency visit.

As an organisation, this group of veterinary practices is very poorly run. I’ve been to this clinic and their emergency vet in Streatham, and both are run down, understaffed and visibly dirty. I could look past those things if the service and staff were excellent, but unfortunately that hasn’t been my experience either.

I’ve noticed on several visits that one younger woman on reception is consistently rude to people. She comes across as defensive, hostile and constantly ready for an argument. I’ve witnessed the way she speaks to other customers before and always thought, “I really hope she never speaks to me like that.” Well, today was the day.

I arrived 15 minutes early for my appointment, having paid £17 for an Uber Pet, only to be told that my appointment had been cancelled because they were dealing with an emergency. She had apparently just tried to call me, literally seconds before I arrived. So effectively, I was given 15 minutes’ notice of a cancelled appointment that I was already travelling to.

Obviously I was frustrated. I expressed that frustration politely, only to immediately be met with hostility, defensiveness and what felt like a lecture about a dying pet.

The emergency itself is not what I am angry about. Of course emergencies happen at a veterinary practice and of course an animal in a critical condition needs immediate attention. What I object to is being treated as though I was unreasonable for being frustrated that I had been given virtually no notice whatsoever.

As someone with autism, sudden changes of plan are particularly difficult for me. I simply explained that 15 minutes was not sufficient notice to cancel an appointment and that I had already spent £17 getting there and would now have to pay for another Uber home. I am £33 out of pocket for absolutely nothing.

If the clinic were adequately staffed, it should be better equipped to deal with emergencies without the entire service falling apart around them. And even where an unavoidable cancellation does happen, reception staff should be capable of dealing with a frustrated customer with basic empathy and professionalism rather than immediately becoming hostile and defensive.

Again, I am not angry that an emergency took priority. I am angry about how the situation was handled and, in particular, the attitude of the receptionist.

Based on this interaction alone, I will now be cancelling my subscription with this practice for both of my pets and moving them elsewhere.

The receptionist involved needs a serious warning about her conduct and proper training in how to communicate with customers, particularly when those customers are already being inconvenienced through no fault of their own. The way she speaks to people is simply not acceptable.
Hi, Wilson. We must have done something right to get such a good rating from you. We really appreciate you taking the time!
Really happy with the service. Everyone is always helpful and kind. They were able to find me an appointment at short notice
Hi, Iona. We are delighted that you had a great experience with us. Thank you for taking the time to rate us!
Short wait for the appointment. A through examination of Sandie gently carried out. Clear follow up instructions given.

My experience with this surgery was overall poor. Communication before taking my cat in was so-so, although I will say that the nurse and the vet carrying out the procedure were both helpful and professional.

Unfortunately, the surgery failed to send my cat’s blood samples off in time, meaning he now has to go through the whole process again. This is particularly frustrating as the additional visit could have been avoided, and the process is stressful for both him and me. He also needs to be given additional gabapentin and fasted again.

Rather than reimbursing me for the service that wasn’t completed properly, they have offered to waive the cost of repeating it. While I appreciate that they aren’t charging me again, this doesn’t account for the additional costs and inconvenience I’m now having to absorb — including another cab journey, taking more time out of my working day, and putting my cat through another stressful visit.

They also offered a “goody bag” as compensation, but given the circumstances, this didn’t feel particularly appropriate or helpful. I would have expected a more meaningful acknowledgement of the inconvenience and additional costs caused by the surgery’s error.

Overall, while the clinical staff I dealt with were helpful, the administrative failure and the way the situation was handled afterwards have left me very disappointed with the practice.
Always friendly and call him by his name. Always prompt to respond.
Hi, Michelle. Your feedback is highly appreciated. Thank you so much for the review!
Hi, Audrey. We must have done something right to get such a good rating from you. We really appreciate you taking the time!

Thanks to the vet and nurse on our recent appointment, showing much compassion and gentleness with our poorly Rufus, who is not a fan of any vet trips! My admiration and respect for their formula 1 style pit crew skills in taking blood samples with expert speed and no fuss, so Rufus remained pretty calm throughout
Hi, Destinyyb. Thank you so much for rating your experience with us so highly!
This was my first visit with our puppy. The staff were Brilliant , lovely and very helpful and welcoming.

Caring and sensitive approach  to me and my poorly pooch. Really appreciate  all the kind efforts of the staff to getting my pooch back on her feet again.
Every step of the way things were clearly explained  and what steps need to be done so I can bring my dog home and make sure she has the right care for her symptoms

Thank you for such wonderful help and consideration
Hi, Dominic. Your feedback is highly appreciated. Thank you so much for the review!

As this is a corporate business with a number of surgeries the main objective is to make big profits for shareholders holders. This is reflected in the way veterinarians are moved between branches making it often difficult to see the preferred vet. As the vets are under time pressure during a consultation, having to familiarise themselves with an animal’s history takes up valuable time.  In comparison independent veterinary practices where a small permanent team are on hand, provide a much more personal service with continuity of care and is a measure of good practice.
Hi, Stephen. We appreciate the rating, and are glad we could provide you with a positive experience!

We have seen Grace several times with our puppy penny.
In our opinion, Grace is lovely, she  explains everything and most importantly she listens. We never feel like we are being rushed through our appointment.
Some vets talk at you and never ask what you want.
Grace is very professional,  keeps us updated and puts us at ease knowing that our puppy is in safe hands.
Eye wateringly expensive for medicine. Don't use or get a prescription.
Great care for my elderly pet.
The staff are always warm and welcoming. Good service when I need anything booked or done. I'm glad I used this Vet for my Cat.
Great service thank you
Staff were friendly but reception was understaffed with one person trying to manage Phones, visitors and payments
Hi, Alex. Thank you so much for rating your experience with us so highly!
Helpful, professional and kindly (and not part of a chain owned by privatecequity)
An excellent vets- they have always treated our Jack Russell with care and expertise. All the staff are friendly and the vets are knowledgeable and thorough. Would highly recommend.

Vets are OK when you can get through to one. However unfortunately on this occasion as ever they reception staff did not listen n to the questions we asked, did not respond when they said they would and were generally pretty unhelpful.
Wish we had found this vets sooner! The staff are welcoming, friendly and compassionate. The service provided has been excellent. Cannot recommend this vets highly enough!

I called Mayow Vets as my cat had an eye problem there were no appointments until the next day. However Emma called me when they got a cancellation. Thoughtful and appreciated by Marichka and I. Thank you
Very kind. Very understanding about my pet. Took time to explain everything.

The staff are knowledgeable, pleasant and helpful. I know my geriatric rescue cat  will always have the best possible care. It is good to see the same vet on each visit. I have never felt l wasn't listened to or was being rushed and appreciate the concern for owners as well as our pets. Thank you

I have been visitng Mayow Veterinary Surgery since 2012 when I acquired my cat Errol, and as well as the usual feline scraps requiring surgery, he was diagnosed with juvenile epilepsy which required specialist treatment. He has been seizure free for a while, but our recent experience at the surgery went as it always does with excellent veterinary care and customer service from the staff. They like Errol, despite him not being very keen on his visits

I love Mayow vets. They are always caring and reassuring. They make every effort to be helpful to me and my animals. I feel so lucky to have found them!  It has a wonderful combination of family atmosphere and business efficiency.

I was charged £271 for a travel AHC booked 2 weeks in advance (happening on a Saturday).

Absolutely outrageous costs considering there was 0 issues with my pup and the vet spent 3 minutes with him and 10 minutes on paperwork. Would not recommend.

Vannessa was incredibly helpful during our visit. She went above and beyond by giving us some puppy pads and a few treats for our new puppy, which was such a thoughtful touch. She was very knowledgeable about pet plans and took the time to explain everything clearly. On top of that, she helped us locate the closest branch to our home, making things much more convenient for us going forward. Excellent service all around!

Took my cat for dental. The clinic is very reasonably priced and had some very good deals for dental and extractions when I booked. I appreciated that there was a free initial consultation and estimate provided and that the vet herself came and spoke to us when we dropped her off for surgery. I felt my cat was in good hands!
Hi, Alexander. We are delighted that you had a great experience with us. Thank you for taking the time to rate us!

This is only my second visit with Mayo Veterinary Surgery, the first being having my puppy’s second vaccinations last November and today to have the free neutering consultation. Both visits have been great, today Nessa was checked over and given a clean bill of health and because she doesn’t seem to have had her first season yet I was advised that it would be better to wait for that and then another two months to let everything settle down before carrying out the surgery. Everything was explained fully and I was impressed that Nessa’s health and needs were paramount and there was no question of her being neutered earlier, just to get the fee.
I feel I have found a vet that I trust and will help me keep Nessa fit and well for many years. Full marks to the lady on reception who was lovely to Nessa and very complementary about her exceptional ears!!!
Hi, Lizzie. Your feedback is highly appreciated. Thank you so much for the review!

Very kind and professional people really helped me through one of my issues. Can’t wait to bring my cat there as they are so helpful and knowledgeable. I highly recommend them. Especially the manager Sam
We always feel so well looked after and listened to, thank you for taking care of my boy Panini
I am always happy with the professionalism and niceness at Mayow Vets. Highly recommend!

My cat needed dental work and the staff were lovely. My cat is going blind and can't see well so I asked the vet to talk to her, tell her what they're doing ie shaving her leg for iv etc. The vet didn't just talk to her, she sang to her, calming my cat. This to me is going above and beyond. The aftercare was excellent. They didn't just hand me a paper telling me what to look out for,  the vet took the time to talk me thru everything they did and the after care. I cant recommend this vets enough. They were brilliant x

Needed a clinic open on Sunday and found Mayow. Very happy with my experience, all the staff were super helpful, and friendly. Our carrier broke on the way there (and as a result we had to bring out cat in a backpack which he didn't like one bit). the staff here gave us a donated carrier they had around, so that our journey back was much more pleasant.

The Mayow road vets really sorted out our cat Bailey. So well. He had a nasty nail pad infection. The vet Grace Atkins brilliantly treated it and cut his nails.
We thought he would need sedation but she sorted straight away with minimal distress and kept the price down.
We are very grateful and highly recommend this vet and Grace.
Thank you

I phoned Mayow with an emergency for my cat, Roxi and was asked to come in right away. I was greeted at reception and Roxi was taken away to be monitored. Everyone was lovely and made sure I knew what was going on. Particular shout out to Toni the receptionist and Vincent the vet who were thorough and friendly. Roxi always feels well looked after at Mayow 💗
Always helpful and informative
A very good experience, from beginning to end. Brought a cat to be neutered and was given assurances and clarity throughout the process.
Warm. welcoming staff.  Quick and efficent!
very helpful and efficient. Friendly service. Kaleb is in good hands. They answer any question I have and would recommend them to anyone.
Hi, Conner. Your feedback is highly appreciated. Thank you so much for the review!
Another good experience with Mayow vets. Urgent pills for cat made available efficiently. Reception were great and thanks also to Vanessa who took the call and Felicity
Fantastic service from the team, who saw us very quickly for a lap spay for our sprocker. Very easy to communicate with, fair price for the surgery and lovely premises.

Had a very good experience with mayow vet's. It's difficult with a reactive dog!  the receptionist was very friendly and helpful. The vet was very friendly and very polite and very helpful! Was by far the best vet experience I've had and I will definitely be back! Thanks mayow vet's.

I took my cat to be put down here, and paid because i thought that would ensure she would have a more peaceful experience this way. It has taken me years to write this review as it was a very sad experience and when I think about my cats end of life unfortunately this is what I remember.

My cat was blind and very poorly in her carrier as we waited in the waiting area. A vet brought a golden retriever out and continued to very slowly try to put a cone on him. but the dog was restless and continued to come over to my cat making her more scared. When I asked the family to get the dog to stay with them on the other side of the vet he proceeded to be rude and curse at both me and my mum. The vets did nothing and did not try to help the situation or contain the dog or even bring him into a room.

i was charged the same amount and there was no apology, but I really wish i never went here as these were the last moments i had with my old childhood cat after a great life together.
Lovely staff, always so polite
Great vets. Very receptive and caring!
Receptions. Tina Chloe very helpful as was Tilly the vet who treated Bella my westie.   Very caring staff  and very helpful
Everyone that works there is lovely and you know they care. I wouldn’t want to take my pets anywhere else

The nurses were so gentle with my cat and so thorough in making sure I understood the treatment, any side effects and how to look after him post surgery.

Bon Bon is always happy to see his vet and she is so gentle and good with him (hes a spicy cat so I was so surprised at how well he behaved for her!)

The team at reception are lovely and helpful.

Always quick visits and amazing staff ! Starting from the girls at the reception followed by the vets ! Never had an issue with booking last minute appointments for my dog . I've been extremely satisfied with their service for years.
Highly recommended 👌 …
The atmosphere and staff are so, friendly. Highly recommend to everyone. Well done to all the staff for your hard work. See you all next time x
Very welcoming for both me and my pet she felt calm on her first visit they were so friendly and quick at seeing to my cat.
Appointment sorted out quickly, pet seen promptly, understanding and helpful vet.
Always excellent service from the team at Mayow. Our dog was recently attacked and sustained a nasty bite; Toni called the next day just to check up on him (and us!). Lovely, thoughtful gesture.
Very friendly staff team and excellent level of expertise in the staff
Such lovely care ! Boe loves coming to the vets as the staff are so kind and patient with him! Highly recommend!
Nurse Lucy was very competent and caring for my dog

I moved from the Neighbourhood Vet after 11 years because I found their new payment policy objectionable: overbearing, hectoring and menacing, esp in my personal circumstances (tied up with hospital visits for blood transfusions), even though they were putting the claim through insurance.
Peckham Vets/Mayow is what TNV used to be like before they sold to a global vets practice and before Simon Knowles left....just as knowledgeable but friendly, relaxed, too.
Also, just discovered that they charge less for prescriptions, and will write more repeats for that fee, meaning I don't have to return more often for more prescriptions.
V smooth and easy.
Lovely friendly and professional every time
Hi, Johana. We are delighted that you had a great experience with us. Thank you for taking the time to rate us!
Always a great service, quick, efficient and knowledgeable staff, my pet always loves coming to the vet.
Amazing vets. Treated our little cat “Popcorn” brilliantly. Would highly recommend.
Very helpful people. Was able to book apointment for sunday at day before! My cat is gratefull as well. Also cheaper then expected! Thank you guys!
Lovely friendly vets’ I recommend them to everyone. Brilliant efficient and kind.
Affordable vet I paid £62 for a check up and Rabbies vaccine for my dog! Highly recommend.
Friendly but professional staff. The usual veterinary services.

Vincent is an exceptional vet. He spent so much time with me before the procedure on the phone, and again when I dropped my cat off. I never felt rushed and he explained everything clearly. You can tell he’s highly skilled, but also very kind and calm, which makes such a difference when you are as worried as I was. My cat is recovering really well.

The reception team, nurses and other vets are all brilliant too. Everyone at mayow is professional and compassionate.

It’s expensive, but vet care is expensive everywhere. For the level of attention, skill and care we received, it’s worth it.

We have been with Mayow for more than 25 years. Our cats, and us cat parents, have always been treated with courtesy and compassion. The current team are always so welcoming and attentive to our cats and always give a choice of options rather than guiding us to one particular course of action.

I can't praise the team at Mayow Vets highly enough. They took exceptional care of our puppy and kept me regularly updated on the progress of her surgery. I had absolute confidence in the fact that she was in more than capable hands. We knew her treatment plan would be fluid depending on what was found and they were open and transparent about the various costs and options the entire way, even during the surgery, so that we could make an informed choice. I would definitely recommend them.
Friendly service and easy to get an appointment. Love tge online booking feature. Such welcoming front of house staff and a great vet.
Receptionist friendly and responsive to queries. My pet was well taken care of by the vet.
The vet was very nice & informative & called us with news on our dog.  She was thoughtful & answered our questions with understanding.  Thank you Mayow Vets
Very kind and friendly, saw my dog very quickly and very supportive

Our cat needed work done on her teeth. Vincent was excellent explaining the procedure to us and we felt like our cat would receive very good care. Afterwards the post op explanation was personal and thoughtful.
Hi, Rozzer. Your feedback is highly appreciated. Thank you so much for the review!
Hi, Tony. We appreciate the rating, and are glad we could provide you with a positive experience!
Very friendly receptionists, Dr Magdalane was very kind, caring & professional.
We were seen quickly and already today she’s in less pain jumping up without problems.
Very Happy. Wonderful staff , great service
Hi, Patryk. We must have done something right to get such a good rating from you. We really appreciate you taking the time!
Hi, Daniel. Thank you so much for rating your experience with us so highly!
This vet practise is wonderful. Skilled, kind and caring and fair, reasonable charges. I am so happy to have found them and recommend them highly. 🙏🏼🌟 …

Predatory vets. Opportunistic fear mongering practice very obviously leaning into tactics to get you to spend as much as they can get out of you. No bedside manner or actual care for your animal. The practitioner was mostly interested in making sure I paid and booked for follow up appointment than anything else. I would also challenge the positive reviews with generic one lines listed for this vets.. The following day I went to my trusted vets who gave me an honest and reasonable diagnosis and a course of antibiotics, which cleared the issues right away.  If it were up to this vet my dog would have been sent 4 places for 5 tests, a biopsy and at every turn there was a reason as to why X was going to cost more than Y. The woman who I saw I would avoid at all costs. At one point she had a needle in her hand to inject my dog with something before I had to stop her to ask her what it was and the price.. we didn't need it. Avoid at all costs.
Good vets - very understanding and supportive. We are able to see the same person every time, which works best for an ongoing problem. It’s easy to get an appointment, including on the weekends.
Lovely caring vets. Have seen Anjie and Jessica recently. Both great communicators. Trust them completely.

My chihuahua was seen by one of the vets at mayow veterinary surgery as an emergency,
And they was amazing, my dog is not very friendly sometimes and they was so patient with him!
Superb very compassionate and professional staff
Very friendly team, took everything seriously and Magda the vet was excellent, reassuring and thorough. Price also very reasonable!

They are wonderful! I highly recommend them. I’m too tired after my experience (it turned out my baby is fine ☺️) to write too much or to be specific but my summary is that they are kind, gentle, professional and they respectful the cat parents’ emotional state when we are worried and they love their fur clients. I referred my friend when she got her kittens and have accompanied her when she brought them for vaccinations. The vet treated them as if they were her own babies. Weekend opening too is just brilliant! Thank you (the photo is of her after opiates. She’s hilarious!)
Always met with a smile here and they are lovely to my dog. Really recommend
I’ve been with this vet for a number of years and always been pleased with the service. We also pay for the VIP package which is really cost effective.
Hi, Lucy. Thank you so much for rating your experience with us so highly!
Hi, Robin. We are delighted that you had a great experience with us. Thank you for taking the time to rate us!
Hi, Adam. Your feedback is highly appreciated. Thank you so much for the review!
Very kind and compassionate from illness through to our cats passing. Lovely staff there
Hi, Tomasz. We appreciate the rating, and are glad we could provide you with a positive experience!
I’ve been taking my cats here for 7 years and am very happy with the service here. All the vets and reception staff are lovely, friendly and helpful.

I remember taking our family pet to Parish Lane as a young girl with my Mum, Brian was the head vet at the time.  Now I have my own pets and after having had very bad experiences with local vet practices I travel 60mins to visit Mayow/Parish Lane and wouldn't go anywhere else, all the staff at Mayow are lovely, the care they give to my Bentley, even just for nail trimming is outstanding. I would give 10 stars if I could.
Always a good service, run by a team who clearly care greatly about the animals. Thank you!

The whole team at Mayow Vets (and their other branches too) are fantastic. The most recent care my two dogs have received in the last couple of weeks has been first class. Big shout out to the reception staff who went above and beyond to manage a multitude of appointments for my puppy with his broken leg and his big sister with gastroenteritis.

The kind and friendly reception staff make the whole experience of going to this vet a lot less stressful. Chloe in particular put me at ease with my dog's issue and they also liaised well with another vet, and my insurance company. The vets themselves are also very very good. Highly recommend and look forward to returning.

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

I had such a great experience with Mayow Vets. From the moment I contacted them, the team were professional, kind, and very supportive. They made the process of transferring my cat Blue’s medical records smooth and stress-free, and when we came in for his appointment, the care and attention he received was excellent.

It’s clear they genuinely care about the animals and the owners too everything was explained clearly, and I felt reassured that Blue was in safe hands. Thank you to the whole team for being so welcoming and making what could have been a stressful time feel calm and positive.

Highly recommend Mayow Vets to any pet owner looking for a clinic that combines expertise with compassion.

Wonderful care and treatment from vet Angie who provided dental care including an extraction for our cat Cola. He would not eat following the extraction and on Sunday I brought him in as I was becoming so worried. Angie administered a tablet to improve his appetite which did the trick. I cannot thank her enough.
Fantastic service. Very personable and professional.
My pup is always happy to see the vets at Mayo clinic,we are happy.

My two adult rescue cats are registered at Mayow Vets and have visited several times over the years for check ups/boosters and a dental appointment. The ladies at reception are lovely and helpful and I've always been satisfied with their service. I have processing difficulties at times but I've never felt uncomfortable or rushed when asking to clarify something.
I've also received outstanding service from Dr Jess and Dr Remi on separate occasions. My boys get quite nervous at the vets, like a lot of pets. Both vets spoke to and handled my cats as if they were their own - sweetly, gently and expertly. It is obviously they understand and respect animals/cats. In each instance, I felt my concerns and questions were listened to and answered, and my efforts to give my cats the best care at home were taken seriously and appreciated. Both vets are very calm, attentive, present, professional, knowledgeable and caring. Nothing is over the top. Everything is reassuring and reasonable. Thank you so very much!

I was really worried and upset about my boy Bruce, I was in tears in the waiting room. Thought I would be leaving without my boy. But Jess (vet), Toni & Abbie on reception were absolutely wonderful and supportive. Now back at home with my Bruce and his medication. Thank you so much, such a relief ♥️
Easy to book an appointment and vets are always friendly and helpful

I can highly recommend this wonderful veterinary surgery.
We were able to get an appointment easily for our cat Fluffy, despite it being a Sunday
They were extremely accommodating to our available times and eager to help.
Everyone that we met from the moment we arrived at reception to our  appointment with our vet Magdalen were friendly ,helpful, warm and welcoming but at the same  time  professional.
Our Fluffy was examined thoroughly with the utmost care and sensitivity.
He is usually petrified when out of his comfort zone but he was noticeably different here, Magdalen managed to put Fluffy at ease very quickly.
Magdalen our vet took her time to answer  anything we asked with patience and clarity.  We felt Fluffy was in very good hands.
We will most definitely be taking our cats here again.
The surgery has a lovely feel to it, the waiting area is bright  welcoming and clean.
I felt our fees were not extortionate considering it was a Sunday,  parking was immediately outside and overall we had a positve experience at this very professional but warm surgery.
Really appreciate everyone today
Once more , we highly recommend Mayow veterinary surgery.
Great service. Lovely caring staff 🥰 …
very kind courteous and professional service. always there to help.

I am very happy with the service I have received regarding my cat Teddy, he is recovering well after having two teeth out, and is happy. The staff at Mayor vets are very friendly and polite and looked after Teddy. I would like to say Thank you for getting me and Teddy though this time.
Very helpful, pleasant, knowledgeable.

Mayow Road Vets have been amazing. When my vet couldn’t do the procedure needed for our kitten Mayow Road stepped in and helped. They have been communicative and clear with pricing every step of the way. Vincent who performed the operation was the ultimate professional. Thank you!
Hi, Antonio. We must have done something right to get such a good rating from you. We really appreciate you taking the time!
Hi, Dr Zerrin. Thank you so much for rating your experience with us so highly!

Fantastic service from all. I came away from this appointment feeling very reassured that my pets health concerns were taken seriously and dealt with promptly. Thank you so much for the wonderful service yet again.

I've only changed to Mayow Vets last year but have to say I'm happy with the service so far. All staff are very friendly and you get the feeling they really care about the animals. Prices are also very reasonable and Vets are always awailable for follow up questions.
Lovely welcoming environment. Staff were polite, friendly and happy to help. Highly recommend!
I go with my dog once a month and everything I go reception and vets are lovely. Magda is really great vet.
Really good vets, been so helpful with my 15 year old cat. Good advice and great with my cat.
Very professional and friendly, they looked after my cat and made her feel comfortable.
Brilliant service from all staff!

Very effective and friendly team. Calm advice about my cat's teeth. No pressure to book treatment. Easy to make an appointment for dental surgery. Friendly and helpful reception staff. Kind, patient vet (Randa). Thorough post op advice. My cat seems to be doing fine.

We are always welcomed warmly at Mayow vets. Magda our vet has seen Fergus since he was a puppy and has always been wonderful with him. The ladies behind the desk are always busy but efficient, but always have time for tasty treats.

Brought our older girl in for an appointment with Angie (not sure of spelling) - lovely, clear and honest. Reception staff are wonderful too. Hopefully won’t be back too much but know we are in good hands when we do :)
This was my first visit to the surgery. The staff are friendly and polite. We got seen to very quickly and my kitten was made comfortable and his issues was treated. Extremely happy with the care
Great practice-called, booked and seen within the hour with a satisfactory outcome. I would recommend.

We are longstanding customers of Mayow Vets and really appreciate the care that the team of vets, nurses and support team offer. Our cat Maxi recently went missing and Vanessa at Mayow Vets branch was so kind and helpful 😊 really was appreciated. Highly recommend. Tamsin …

Our dog visits Mayow Vet every 6 months for her wellness check up. The front desk, no matter who is there, are all very friendly and happy to speak to clients! Most recently, my dog had a scale and polish for her teeth, and there was some discrepancy with insurance on direct payment versus claiming back. The reception and insurance teams at Mayow were quick to action replies and help get things processed for me ASAP. The vets are also awesome of course and our dog is happy to see them everytime! Thanks Mayow Vet!
Best veterinary practice for my cat available in Sydenham.

All of the staff here were lovely, I felt very reassured leaving my cat in their capable hands.  The waiting room is a bit pokey and can quickly feel over-crowded, which can be a bit stressful for the animals.  Had some mixed messages between what we were told on discharge, and what subsequent vets have said at follow-up appointments, which has been a bit confusing.

Vets are good but communication is absolutely shocking. I have now called four times and each time have been told that someone will call me back or been given the wrong information. Each time I've had to call back as I still haven't heard anything and it's been days, sometimes weeks in between. Really not impressed at all.

This is the worst experience with a vet practice I have ever had. I brought my cat in for a repeat ultrasound scan as he’d had chronic pancreatitis for over a year but was otherwise healthy. The vet who performed the scan, Will, told me his pancreas was very inflamed, had lots of cysts in it that likely meant cancer and given his weight loss he only had a couple months to live so basically wasn’t worth pursuing any treatment. I was obviously devastated, missed work, etc. I then brought him to a specialist for a second opinion and they did another scan and said they have no idea what the vet at Mayow had seen because his pancreas was normal size, had one small cyst that looked very benign and his weight was steady. I then found out that Will at Mayow had taken my cat’s weight incorrectly so he thought he had lost 1 kg in a month! Shocking incompetence. There was also someone who phoned me a couple days after the scan from Mayow with some test results saying how rare it was for them to find a tumour in a cat…there was no tumour?! Needless to say, my cat is now on meds and is doing well!!
